topic: Manage Employee Bank Details and Payment Modes
summary: This feature allows users to enter and manage employee bank account details and specify their preferred payment mode for salary. These details will reflect on salary slips.
steps: Click on the employee's name or ID to "View" their details.
Enter or update the "Bank Name", "Branch Name", and "Account Number".
In the "Payment Mode" field, specify how the salary is paid (e.g., "RTGS", "Cheque").
business_rules: Bank details and payment mode entered here will be reflected on the employee's salary slip.
important_notes: Once saved, these details are permanently stored and do not need to be re-entered monthly.
Remarks can be used if specific pop-ups are desired for payment modes, but direct entry in the payment mode field is sufficient for record-keeping.
questions: How do I add or update an employee's bank account details?
Where can I specify if an employee's salary is paid via cheque or RTGS?
Will the bank details appear on the salary slip?
Do I need to enter payment mode details every month?
